title: Lathe Facing on a grooved bar is refused at the post: the sphere-envelope scan counts the groove floor across the spindle as rest

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
## What happens

A lathe Facing that only faces the end of a bar is refused at the post when the bar has a groove anywhere along it. The same Facing on a plain or stepped bar posts. `verify` reports the groove as unremoved rest belonging to the Facing:

```
F2: finish envelope near move 3: 0.0000 mm gouge, 17.0528 mm rest   (blocks_post: true)
post: post blocked - 1 warning(s): F2: finish envelope near move 3: 0.0000 mm gouge, 15.5616 mm rest
```

The groove lies 11 mm below the faced band. No Facing can reach it, and the Groove kinds exist to cut it.

## Reproduction (main 38699549, `camcraft-cli mcp`)

`crates/sim/src/verify/finish.rs`, `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/`, `crates/motion/src/turning/` and `crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs` are unchanged from there to 3f6ecb4a.

The bars are closed revolves about Z with 64 segments, written as ASCII STL from a meridian of (r, z) points:

- **plain:** `(0,0) (10,0) (10,48) (0,48)`
- **stepped:** `(0,0) (10,0) (10,20) (7,20) (7,40) (5,40) (5,48) (0,48)`
- **wider at the free end:** `(0,0) (7,0) (7,20) (10,20) (10,48) (0,48)`
- **groove:** `(0,0) (10,0) (10,34) (5.5,34) (5.5,37) (10,37) (10,48) (0,48)`
- **groove near the top:** `(0,0) (10,0) (10,44) (8,44) (8,46) (10,46) (10,48) (0,48)`
- **shaft:** `(0,0) (10,0) (10,20) (7,20) (7,34) (5.5,34) (5.5,37) (7,37) (7,40) (5,40) (5,48) (0,48)`

```json
[["load_machine", {"path": "assets/machines/lathe.mch"}],
 ["import_model", {"path": "<bar>.stl"}],
 ["set_stock", {"cylinder": {"diameter": 20, "height": 50}}],
 ["add_tool", {"catalog": "TN-1600-0R8"}],
 ["add_operation", {"kind": "facing", "tool": "TN-1600-0R8", "name": "F2", "source": "<bar>",
   "params": {"top_z": {"offset": 0, "reference": "top_of_stock"}, "bottom_z": {"offset": 0, "reference": "top_of_model"}}}],
 ["generate", {"name": "F2"}], ["verify", {}],
 ["post", {"output": "f2.nc", "post": "assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps"}]]
```

The Facing generates 27 moves on each bar: five stations from z 50 down to z 48.

| Bar | `verify` | Post |
|---|---|---|
| plain | no findings | written (42 lines) |
| stepped | no findings | written (with Profile Rough + Finish: 829 lines) |
| wider at the free end | no findings | - |
| groove | `0.0000 mm gouge, 17.0528 mm rest` | blocked |
| groove near the top | `0.0000 mm gouge, 10.2818 mm rest` | blocked |
| shaft | `0.0000 mm gouge, 15.5616 mm rest` | blocked |

## Root cause (confirmed)

Facing's registry row is `mode: Mode::Envelope` (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`, Facing `KindInfo`). Its comment reads: "a meridian circle revolved IS a sphere about the axis, so the scan reads the lathe's own cut". `finish_envelope` (`crates/sim/src/verify/finish.rs`) then runs `stock_sim::envelope_scan_centers` over the pass as it lies in world space, a radial line in the y = 0 half-plane x ≥ 0. The scan never turns the work.

The scan's `rest_mm` includes "material standing hidden under an occluding top" (M2.2d, `EnvelopeReport::rest_mm` in `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/scan.rs`). A groove's floor is an upward face under the bar's full diameter above it, so it counts. Every reported figure equals the distance from the groove floor's outer rim on the far side of the axis (x = −r_rim, y = 0, z = floor) to the last pass's nose centre at the axis (0, 0, 48 + 0.8), less the 0.8 nose:

| Bar | Floor rim | √(r_rim² + (48.8 − z_floor)²) − 0.8 | Reported |
|---|---|---|---|
| groove | r 10, z 34 | 17.06 | 17.0528 |
| groove near the top | r 10, z 44 | 10.29 | 10.2818 |
| shaft | r 7, z 34 | 15.57 | 15.5616 |

The figures sit slightly below the true-circle values because the 64-gon floor rim is a chord.

The Groove rows of the same table already say why a sphere scan cannot judge this ("No sphere can judge a band: a grooved part is undercut BY DESIGN"), and they use `Mode::Revolve`.

Seen on the same shaft, but not root-caused: Profile Rough and Profile Finish (also `Mode::Envelope`) report `12.7553 mm rest` and `0.0073 mm gouge, 12.4890 mm rest` with default heights. A stepped bar without a groove gives them no findings.

## Expected

A Facing is judged on the band it claims, as the turned work sees it. A groove elsewhere on the bar is not its rest, and the program posts as it does on a bar without the groove.

## Suggested labels

Outside contributors can't set labels, so these are suggestions:

- `P3`: a legal turning program is refused.
- `effort:high`: verifier logic; the safety floor.
- `area:turning`
- `source:agent`
